title: On Extending the road to the river bank
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：extend　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 extend 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the builder ① extended the road to the river bank in the rain, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② extends the road to the river bank without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ extend the road to the river bank at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ extended the road to the river bank before — a line in the plan for October 1956 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Extending the road to the river bank in the rain, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ extend a hand to the youngest rider without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Extend a hand to the youngest rider at once and never mention it again.

By 1969 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ extends a hand to the youngest rider in the rain every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ extended the road to the river bank again when nobody else would.

⑩ To extend the road to the river bank, my mother said in 1974, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody extends the road to the river bank without complaint again and somebody must extend the road to the river bank in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 延长（一般过去式 extended the road to the river bank：1962 年施工员头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 延长（一般现在 extends the road to the river bank：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 延长（不定式 to extend the road to the river bank：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 延长（过去完成时 had extended the road to the river bank：1956 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 延长（动名词 extending the road to the river bank 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 伸出（extend a hand to the youngest rider：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去伸出向最小的骑手伸出一只手）
G. v. 伸出（extend a hand to the youngest rider：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 延长（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 extends a hand to the youngest rider，而母亲又一次 extended the road to the river bank）

answers.why: extend 意为“延长”，1962 年施工员淋着雨延长把路延伸到河岸，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 extended。
extend 意为“延长”，自那以后施工员毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 extends。
extend 意为“延长”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯延长把路延伸到河岸”，此处为不定式 to extend the road to the river bank。
extend 意为“延长”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1969 年之前就有人延长过，故用过去完成时 had extended。
extend 意为“延长”，施工员说“延长把路延伸到河岸这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 extending the road to the river bank 作主语。
extend 意为“伸出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去伸出向最小的骑手伸出一只手”，should ever 之后用原形 extend a hand to the youngest rider。
extend 意为“伸出”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻伸出向最小的骑手伸出一只手（extend a hand to the youngest rider at once），以后再也不要提起。
extend 意为“延长”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例伸出向最小的骑手伸出一只手，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 extends。
extend 意为“延长”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨延长把路延伸到河岸，用一般过去式 extended 叙述。
extend 意为“延长”，结尾那句是母亲 1974 年的话：要延长把路延伸到河岸，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1962 年，施工员淋着雨延长把路延伸到河岸；工地里每一个帮工都说这是头一回。（extended the road to the river bank）
多年以后，施工员仍毫无怨言地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（extends the road to the river bank）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯延长把路延伸到河岸这件事本身。（to extend the road to the river bank）
早在 1956 年就有人延长把路延伸到河岸，十月那天施工图上的一行字就是证据。（had extended the road to the river bank）
施工员说过，淋着雨延长把路延伸到河岸这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（extending the road to the river bank 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻伸出向最小的骑手伸出一只手，以后再也不要提起。（extend a hand to the youngest rider，祈使句）
answers: In 1962 the builder extended the road to the river bank in the rain, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three months on, the builder still extends the road to the river bank without complaint without being asked.
My mother said later that to extend the road to the river bank at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had extended the road to the river bank long before 1969, and the line in the plan for October proves it.
Extending the road to the river bank in the rain, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Extend a hand to the youngest rider at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 extend 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1962 the builder extended the road to the river bank in the rain, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder extends the road to the river bank without complaint whenever the site asks.
Extending the road to the river bank in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever extend a hand to the youngest rider without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site extends a hand to the youngest rider in the rain every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother extended the road to the river bank again, and the site remembered that half.
